acceptanceCriteria: SessionStart and evidence-bearing UserPromptSubmit emit one short systemMessage; prompts with zero results inject at most a one-line notice.
The plugin ships the listed skills, each mapped to the existing CLI with its uncertainty preserved.
Host lifecycle qualification on the installed Claude Code observes the message in the terminal and the desktop Code tab, or records NOT_RUN for a surface.
body: Found in a 2026-10-09 audit of the Claude Code plugin (corvint@corvint 0.2.3, Claude Code 2.1.293, Corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, darwin-arm64). Today the user sees nothing from Corvint except a hook spinner: SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit return only hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (model-only, about 3 KB of untrusted JSON per prompt, measured 3074-3076 bytes), and systemMessage is used only for degraded or unresolved Stop. In this session's prompt packet included_results was 0 (resolution explicit-task-anchor-required) yet the full envelope was still injected. The only slash command is /corvint:context. Proposed baseline (hooks.json and skills, so it works in claude -p, the Agent SDK and older hosts where the V1-1054 mod cannot run): (1) a one-line systemMessage on SessionStart and on prompts that injected evidence, naming result count, freshness and degradations; skip the envelope or shrink it to one line when it carries no results (see V1-0296, V1-0320); (2) skills /corvint:impact, /corvint:affected, /corvint:review, /corvint:status (dogfood status with the native key), /corvint:index. Related: V1-1054 (mod pane and status line), V1-0191 (corvint-mcp).
title: Claude Code plugin: user-visible hook summaries and explicit /corvint skills that work where mods do not
